terra.problem: The passage does not say Hezekiah's whole kingdom was nervous.
Saying Sennacherib wanted everybody to know about the trees assigns him a motive the text does not give.
The text says the grass is scorched before it is grown; it does not say rooftop grass has no chance against the sun.
The LORD knowing about Sennacherib's rage does not establish that it was not secret.
The text does not specify a first sit-down or a last step.
The passage does not say Sennacherib showed up thinking he would walk into Jerusalem.
The closing instruction to always check the verse sounds generic and corrective rather than like Papa Dorin.
The LORD says Sennacherib will not build a siege ramp; the explanation broadens that to a claim that no ramp ever gets built.
The explanation quotes the verse and repeats that it names two reasons, without bringing Papa Dorin's warmth or teaching voice to it.
The mapmaker joke has no clear logical connection to the action and clashes with the promise to handle this heavy moment plainly.
Calling Esar-haddon a mouthful makes the sound of a person's name the joke.
